{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a variety of Python versions
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-python

name: run_tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "**" ]
  schedule:
     - cron: "15 0 1,6,11,16,21,26 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
  
jobs:
  unittests:
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.13", "3.14"]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup conda
      uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
      with:
        activate-environment: anaconda-client-env
    - name: Cache conda packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          ~/miniconda/pkgs
          C:\Miniconda\pkgs
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-conda-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-conda-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-conda-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        conda install -c conda-forge python=${{ matrix.python-version }} mamba pytest -y
        mamba install -c conda-forge kineticstoolkit --only-deps -y
    - name: Test with pytest and crash on warnings (macos, without extensions)
      if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
      run: |
        export PYTHONPATH=":kineticstoolkit"
        echo "Running tests with PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH"
        pytest tests --ignore='tests/interactive' -W error::RuntimeWarning
    - name: Test with pytest and crash on warnings (linux, without extensions)
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
      run: |
        export PYTHONPATH=":kineticstoolkit"
        echo "Running tests with PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH"
        pytest tests --ignore='tests/interactive' -W error::RuntimeWarning
    - name: Test with pytest and crash on warnings (windows, without extensions)
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        export PYTHONPATH=";kineticstoolkit"
        echo "Running tests with PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH"
        pytest tests --ignore='tests/interactive' -W error::RuntimeWarning",
  "rationale": "The workflow installs conda dependencies on every run without caching. Adding a cache for the conda package directory (~miniconda/pkgs on Unix, C:\Miniconda\pkgs on Windows) keyed by OS, Python version, and pyproject.toml hash will reuse downloaded packages across runs, reducing installation time. This is supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) and experiment example for P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE which showed ~9% elapsed time savings for a similar pip caching step.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
